tests.actor: tenant-a admin or public host context
tests.attempt: List/search a resource with colliding tenant-b values.
assertions: Only tenant-a records are returned.
No tenant-b identifier, count or aggregate is disclosed.
No state changes in either tenant.

tests.actor: tenant-a admin, public host context or signing device
tests.attempt: Read tenant-b event, entry, document, session, job or child ID directly.
assertions: Response is indistinguishable from not found and contains no tenant-b data.
No state changes in either tenant.

tests.attempt: Create, update, delete, restore, finalize or attach using a tenant-b parent or resource ID.
assertions: The operation is rejected or affects zero rows.
No tenant-b data is returned.
Database, object, job, cache and audit state is unchanged except an allowed tenant-a denial audit.

tests.attempt: Create, poll or download an export with tenant-b event/job/object IDs.
assertions: No export contains tenant-b rows.
No tenant-b job is claimed or changed.
No presigned URL for tenant-b is issued.

tests.attempt: Generate, sign, attach or download with tenant-b entry, signer, document or session IDs.
assertions: No document or evidence is generated or returned.
No tenant-b signing/document state changes.
No tenant-b object key is exposed.

tests.attempt: Request upload/download signing for a tenant-b key or reuse a tenant-a URL with a substituted key.
assertions: No URL is issued for the foreign key.
The object store policy rejects namespace escape.
No object is read, created or overwritten.

tests.actor: worker with immutable tenant-a job context
tests.attempt: Deliver a payload containing tenant-a organizationId and tenant-b resource/object IDs, or omit organizationId.
assertions: The worker fails closed before business mutation.
No tenant-b row, object, mail or job state changes.
Retry/deduplication remains scoped to tenant-a.

tests.actor: one browser/process switching from tenant-a to tenant-b
tests.attempt: Populate tenant-a caches, sessions and local state, then resolve tenant-b.
assertions: Tenant-b never receives cached tenant-a data or authority.
Cache keys include server-issued organization/bootstrap identity or are cleared on switch.
Global reference caches contain no tenant-owned values.

tests.attempt: Use the same idempotency key and colliding business values in both tenants, then retry with foreign parents.
assertions: Deduplication happens only within one organization.
Neither tenant can discover or suppress the other's request.
Foreign-parent retries make no state change.

tests.attempt: Query audit/operational evidence and emit a tenant-owned action.
assertions: Tenant-a queries disclose no tenant-b records or dimensions.
Tenant-owned records include organizationId from trusted context.
Platform-global evidence contains no tenant payload and has an explicit global event type.

tests.actor: tenant-a approval proposal service and configured notification chat
tests.attempt: Send a notification containing tenant-b actionId, payload reference or action kind while executing in tenant-a context.
assertions: The notification is rejected before delivery and the tenant-a chat receives no tenant-b action kind, payload reference or callback data.
No approval or denial callback can address the tenant-b action.
The fallback notification path also emits no tenant-b payload and neither tenant's approval state changes.

tests.attempt: Use CLI, repair, restore, migration, signing-terminal or diagnostic tooling with tenant-b IDs/keys.
assertions: The tool requires trusted organization context and refuses the foreign target.
No tenant-b data is printed, persisted or mutated.
Dry-run and apply summaries remain tenant-scoped.

tests.attempt: Use a deliberately global reference/infrastructure resource from both tenants.
assertions: The resource contains no tenant-owned payload or mutable tenant branding/configuration.
Tenant activity cannot evict, overwrite or disclose another tenant's state.
Any tenant-derived key is namespaced before entering the global container.

tests.actor: migration runner on the two-tenant fixture
tests.attempt: Apply/upgrade/rollback schema and data migrations with both organizations present.
assertions: Ownership columns and constraints reconcile for both tenants.
Backfills use an explicit event-to-organization mapping.
No row/object/job is assigned to the wrong tenant.

tests.attempt: Validate a change adding a tenant-capable resource without classification or a named negative test.
assertions: CI fails for missing/malformed inventory records.
CI fails when the named test is absent from this matrix.
Global classification requires a non-empty rationale.
